description: Hard safety gates are independent from contextual research metrics.

modeled_mutation_score.context: Report the bounded modeled population; do not turn it into a universal quality threshold.

meaningful_mutation_score.context: This score uses only explicit MEANINGFUL_SEMANTIC classifications and has a small denominator.

covered_source_locations.context: Line coverage guides execution and is not a semantic adequacy claim.

held_out_score_change.context: Two one-mutant folds are evidence, not a general transfer-rate estimate.
